description: Compare two people's Human Design charts: sparks (channels each completes for the other), shared channels, who sets the tone, centers they define only together, and how one's Venus meets the other's Mars, as short plain lines with a link to the free compatibility page. Use when someone asks "are we compatible in Human Design", "our Human Design together", or names two types and wants to know how they work. Exact charts from the same ephemeris as the site, not a guess from type names. Birth times and places are optional; without them the result says what can change. "you" is the person asking, "them" the other. Takes birth details only, never names or contact details, and stores nothing. It describes tendencies for reflection, never a verdict on whether a relationship will work or last.

them.description: Birth details of the other person, only what the user chose to share. No name or contact details.

birth_place.description: Birthplace as city, region, country, e.g. Austin, Texas, United States. Gives coordinates (and the time zone if time_zone is left out).

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude, if the city is not found. Optional.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude (east positive), with latitude. Optional.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago. Work it out from the birthplace. Needed with a birth_time unless birth_place is in our list.

you.description: Birth details of the person asking. No name or contact details.
